'''Kortho Hatanga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] cargo hauler and part-time [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was native to the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].
From a young age, Hatanga hauled cargo across the space lanes of the Elrood [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and he eventually became the operator of the [[X46-7-Class Ore Carrier|X46-7 ore carrier]] ''[[Galax Titan]]''. However, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Hatanga was stripped of his [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] license and the majority of his [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] permits as a consequence of a drink problem that he had developed. Despite losing his permits, Hatanga agreed to transport the [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Mikos Argdran]] and a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]] to the restricted planet [[Derilyn]], aboard the ''Galax Titan''. En route, the ore carrier was attacked by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], but the attackers were forced by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderflare]]'' to retreat and Hatanga reluctantly accepted an offer from [[Tanda Pryl]], the captain of the ''Thunderflare'', to have the Star Destroyer escort the ''Galax Titan'' the rest of the way to Derilyn.

==Personality and traits==
Kortho Hatanga was a hard-drinking, grizzled space dog, who had fierce eyes and gaunt features. Hatanga was coarse and gruff, and he advocated the application of [[The Code of the Stars]], an old-fashioned systems of ethics.
